title: fix(pm): check-owed-reviews names the area-lease exception beside a barred review seat

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：欠审表工具 `check-owed-reviews.mjs` 遇到「复核席与 PR 同账号、被判 barred」时，报告里多一行说明：area-lease 模式下维护者可以在该复核线程亲字让同账号席复核，但本工具只读 GitHub、看不到那句话，所以这里仍显示 barred，接手前请先看复核线程（`--json` 输出里同一句放在 `notes`）。
- 为什么改：以前报告把同账号席一律写成 barred，注释也说这条是无条件的，和 `area-lease.md` 的例外对不上，席位读报告会以为没有独立复核人可用。
- 风险与回滚：只多打印一行说明，判定不变：同账号席仍是 barred，接手人仍是车道席，不会放行任何复核。只改 `scripts/pm/` 工具，回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` / `reportNotes` 与 `renderReport` 里加的那两行；② 同文件 `reviewSeatsOf` 里 `isBarred` 上方的注释；③ 自测里新加的 area-lease 一条。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`，应看到 `✓ check-owed-reviews self-test: 90 cases pass in 10 batteries`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`area-lease.md` lets a review seat on the PR's own account review it when the maintainer's own word seats it in that review thread (「同账号须维护者在该复核线程亲字」), and `lanes/review.md` 独立性 points at that exception. That word lives in a project review thread, which this tool cannot read: it reads GitHub only, and no GitHub carrier for it is defined on `main` (searched `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` for a seat-post field or ruling line naming it; `parseSeat` reads lane, seat, status and account only). So this takes the card's second route, the output one, and invents no carrier:

- `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` (exported constant) and `reportNotes(rows)` (pure): when any row bars a review seat, the text report prints the note once (a line starting with the scales emoji, above any INCOMPLETE block), and `--json` carries it as a top-level `notes` array. With no barred seat there is no note.
- The bar itself is unchanged. A same-account seat stays `barred` and the taker stays the lane seat, so the tool keeps erring toward over-barring and never waves a review through.
- The `isBarred` comment names the area-lease exception and why this reader cannot see it, instead of calling the bar unconditional; the header's `review seat` reading says the same.

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` on head 36eda265: `✓ check-owed-reviews self-test: 90 cases pass in 10 batteries` (base fb79d47c: 89 cases).

One new pin in the review-seat battery (floor 16 → 17): two TAKE rows whose only review seat sits on the PR's own account stay `barred` with the lane seat as taker; their report carries exactly one note line equal to `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE`; a report with no barred seat carries none, and `reportNotes` agrees both ways. Round 1 of review (S1 of 6898496953) strengthened the existing `--json` case: it also asserts the top-level `notes` equals `reportNotes(doc.rows)`; case count unchanged at 90.

## Acceptance notes

- Not governed: `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` is outside the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` rows.
- `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing.

## Verification

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head 36eda265 (and before it 58de1f3e): 31 derived, each run (nine first ran before `pnpm install` in the fresh worktree: seven exited 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, and `check-self-test-workflow-commands` exited 1 both ways because a script it drives needed the dependencies; all nine re-run after the install), all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`. CI-run families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
